studies.title: The passenger pigeon
studies.caption: A passenger pigeon rests beneath a passing flock. The species once filled the skies over eastern North America's forests before mass hunting drove it to extinction.
studies.prompt: Close adult male Ectopistes migratorius perched on oak branch, blue-grey head, warm rose-rufous breast, iridescent neck patch, small dark bill, red eye, long pointed graduated tail. Distant loose flock crossing deciduous forest sky. Not stocky city pigeon, no bands or people.
